pages.text: [#](53341a)The rowan is unremarkable to look at — a slender tree with silver bark, prone to growing in unlikely places. But it carries a sympathy with the unseen world that the other trees do not, and that makes it indispensable.[#]()
pages.title: The Rowan Tree

pages.text: [#](53341a)Grow one from a sapling mutated with Mutandis, or find one in the wild. Its logs feed your altar; its planks build your tools; its berries have their own quiet uses.[#]()
[#](53341a)The berries go into several brews, and burned in a brazier they give a mild healing aura. Do not discard them.[#]()
pages.title: Rowan Berries
